about: Elements that get no hint card and no hover. Self-explanatory action buttons and what Victor removed (16.11.2026). Owned by T0: a zone task adds candidates to its notes, it does not edit this file. 'selector' is what the engine opts out (the element and everything inside it); the audit marks such elements as opted-out, not as misses. HX.optout(selector) does the same at run time.
